answer: Onboarding costs a real paid inference: the newcomer answers the epoch challenge with a hosted model (a sonnet-tier completion) and seals the provider's completion record - model, request hash, billing id. That record's hash is the relic, and only a fresh, unused relic can bridge a new identity into the network. Every twin must earn its own paid, non-reusable completion, so a sybil farm pays list price per clone, forever; a duplicate-receipt burn covers reuse. Cost scales linearly with clones.
